subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should OpenClaw support Bedrock Anthropic beta flags through a generic user-configurable request-field passthrough, a narrow `context1m`/1M-context switch, or no new config surface?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes provider config/request-body surface and repository policy treats new config/default/provider behavior as compatibility-sensitive maintainer product direction.

options.title: Add Bedrock-owned passthrough
options.body: Expose a narrowly validated Bedrock provider config shape for `additionalModelRequestFields` or `anthropic_beta`, merge it with existing runtime betas, document it, and add regression tests.

options.title: Add only a 1M switch
options.body: Restore a Bedrock-specific `context1m` path that injects the dated 1M beta without opening a general request-field passthrough.

options.title: Decline config surface
options.body: Keep the provider lean and close the request, accepting that Bedrock users must wait for hardcoded provider updates when beta flags change.

recommendation.title: Add Bedrock-owned passthrough
recommendation.body: Expose a narrowly validated Bedrock provider config shape for `additionalModelRequestFields` or `anthropic_beta`, merge it with existing runtime betas, document it, and add regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Bedrock payload builder and latest release-side provider runtime are attributed to this contributor in git history, making them the best available owner for the provider contract choice.
